property_summary: When RState is BELOW_ONE and reserves are equal to targets, calling correctRState must NOT change RState (it stays BELOW_ONE) unless reserves are strictly less than targets.

When RState is BELOW_ONE and base reserve equals base target, calling buyShares should not result in a BASE_TARGET greater than the post-call BASE_RESERVE (i.e., BASE_TARGET must be <= BASE_RESERVE) in the original but the mutant can violate this.
After calling buyShares from any state with nonzero base input, the contract's stored BASE_TARGET must never exceed the new BASE_RESERVE (BASE_TARGET <= BASE_RESERVE).

If before buyShares the contract is in BELOW_ONE and base reserve equals base target, then after buyShares the BASE_TARGET must not increase by more than the minted shares amount that could be attributed to the buy (i.e., the new BASE_TARGET minus previous BASE_TARGET is <= shares minted to caller).

If BEFORE buyShares the pool is in BELOW_ONE with base reserve equal to base target, then AFTER buyShares the contract's BASE_TARGET must remain <= the post-call BASE_RESERVE (i.e., BASE_TARGET does not exceed reserves).

property_summary: For any mtFeeRate input the reference contract preserves _BASE_TARGET_ when reserves equal targets (i.e., calling adjustMtFeeRate never changes _BASE_TARGET_), but the mutant can mistakenly reset _BASE_TARGET_ to _BASE_RESERVE_ when _RState_==BELOW_ONE and _BASE_RESERVE_ == _BASE_TARGET_, so after adjustMtFeeRate the two contracts can differ in _BASE_TARGET_.
